scope.summary: Independent Review/fix hardening for the QK-05 FOCUS cost-export Plan/Spec/RED artifact and fail-closed future harness validator.
explicit_non_claims: No runtime implementation, billing runtime, price-book/tax/invoice publication, Cost Explorer UI, TrustCenter publishing, provider/IaC state, live billing data, public-cloud fallback, or production-readiness claim is introduced.
The QK-05 checker remains a RED-only guard for future dogfood receipts; a future Build card must wire real runtime verification before positive status can pass.
Pre-existing dirty workspace changes outside this card were not reviewed as part of this changeset.

facets.F2_correctness: Corrected the root-hub pointer citation to the current cloud_production_quality_kits_target entry and made status=passed_after_future_runtime_evidence fail closed in the RED-only validator.
facets.F3_security: No secrets, credentials, provider/IaC state, generated JSON, live billing data, or broad product/control-plane surfaces were edited.
facets.F4_data_boundary: FOCUS references are schema/provenance contracts only; no tenant cost, invoice, or live billing records are introduced.
facets.F5_testing: py_compile, QK-05 self-test, cloud quality-kit backlog check, expected missing-receipt RED failure, and fabricated positive-status rejection were executed and recorded in Kanban closeout.
facets.F6_rollback: Revert the two QK-05 target files and remove this evidence packet if a newer source authority supersedes this RED-only contract.
facets.F7_operability: Future implementation handoff explicitly requires a real runtime verifier before positive dogfood evidence can pass.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime path is affected; validator changes are bounded to local JSON receipt checks.
facets.F9_compliance: Preserves FOCUS 1.3 normalization and FinOps attribution authority without redefining ADR-0199 or the canonical FinOps standard.
facets.F10_reversibility: Additive evidence/check hardening only; no generated artifact, root-hub, provider, or billing runtime mutation.
facets.F11_observability: Kanban closeout and this evidence packet capture the review verdict and verification outputs.
facets.F13_migration: Maintains the Plan/Spec/RED-to-future-Build boundary for quality-kit dogfood evidence migration.
